From fe773b8711e3be4190994ea54bf7a5a0564245a1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Takashi Iwai <tiwai@suse.de>
Date: Sat, 23 Jan 2021 16:58:42 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] ALSA: usb-audio: workaround for iface reset issue

The recently introduced sample rate validation code seems causing a
problem on some devices; namely, after performing this, the bus gets
screwed and it influences even on other USB devices.
As a quick workaround, perform it only for the necessary devices;
currently MOTU devices are known to need the valid altset checks, so
filter out other devices.

Fixes: 93db51d06b32 ("ALSA: usb-audio: Check valid altsetting at parsing rates for UAC2/3")
Reported-by: Jamie Heilman <jamie@audible.transient.net>
BugLink: https://bugzilla.suse.com/show_bug.cgi?id=1178203
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210123155842.22652-1-tiwai@suse.de
Signed-off-by: Takashi Iwai <tiwai@suse.de>

diff --git a/sound/usb/format.c b/sound/usb/format.c
index 9ebc5d202c87..e6ff317a6785 100644
--- a/sound/usb/format.c
+++ b/sound/usb/format.c
@@ -466,6 +466,17 @@ static int validate_sample_rate_table_v2v3(struct snd_usb_audio *chip,
 	unsigned int nr_rates;
 	int i, err;
 
+	/* performing the rate verification may lead to unexpected USB bus
+	 * behavior afterwards by some unknown reason.  Do this only for the
+	 * known devices.
+	 */
+	switch (USB_ID_VENDOR(chip->usb_id)) {
+	case 0x07fd: /* MOTU */
+		break;
+	default:
+		return 0; /* don't perform the validation as default */
+	}
+
 	table = kcalloc(fp->nr_rates, sizeof(*table), GFP_KERNEL);
 	if (!table)
 		return -ENOMEM;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File Modified: `sound/usb/format.c`**
- The patch adds a conditional check at the start of the `validate_sample_rate_table_v2v3` function to filter devices for which sample rate validation should be performed.
- Specifically, it only allows the validation to proceed for devices with the vendor ID `0x07fd` (known to be MOTU devices).
- For other devices (the default case), the function returns `0` immediately, effectively skipping the sample rate validation for them.

### Relationships Between Modifications
- The modification serves as a workaround for an issue caused by recent changes (specifically a sample rate validation addition) which affects the USB bus behavior for some devices. 
- By restricting the validation to only certain devices (MOTU), the patch aims to prevent disruptions that could affect other USB devices connected on the same bus, thus addressing the reported bug without completely removing the validation feature.
